book.name: Paihowa
book.title: PAIHOWA Yesu ꞌana tohepwailao ꞌidi paihowa

content: Topeu siꞌabihe bwebweꞌaneya
Caigeda tuta lahilahiya, Pita Yoni baꞌidana silagalaga Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌoina sabi ꞌahwanoi, weyahina beno ꞌahwanoi ꞌana tuta.

Ma Hada Heꞌasisiina ꞌana ꞌahwaꞌeda sihesaniyeya Causalana deina topeu ꞌaigeda ꞌimiyamiya, tauna ꞌina tuta liꞌu ꞌoinega maꞌina peu, ꞌoinega ꞌiyanao sabwelo ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiya siꞌeweꞌeweyama ꞌahwaꞌedaina ꞌoina ma ꞌiloꞌahwaꞌahwanoi ꞌina mane bo ꞌina tobwatobwa weyahidi, Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌana toluhuwao ꞌoidiya.
Ta topeuina Pita ma Yoni ꞌiꞌitediya ꞌiꞌiuna ma siluhu, ꞌoinega lema weyahina ꞌiꞌahwanoiya ꞌoidiya.
Eeta Pita ma Yoni siꞌebubuya, ta Pita ꞌigwaeya, “Cuꞌebubumai.”
Coinega topeuina ꞌiꞌebubudiya maꞌina hemisa ꞌabehega toꞌaha nata siꞌebwae.
Ta Pita ꞌigwaeya, “Geya ꞌigu manemo, ma hesi helauina ꞌoiguwa ꞌimiyamiya yaꞌebwaego, Toꞌabihetena Yesu, tauna gwama Nasaleta, saninega yaloinego ma ꞌutoholo ma ꞌutauya.”
Ma nima ꞌebeulega ꞌiꞌabihe toholoya, ma ꞌaetubwenao sipaꞌala,
ma ꞌiulataheya ma ꞌitoholowa, ma ꞌoinega ꞌitauya ta baꞌidanao siluhuwa Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌalona, ma loheyaina ꞌiulaula taheya ma ꞌihehepwatu Yehoba ꞌoina.
Coinega boda siꞌiteya topeuina ꞌitautauya maꞌina hepwatu Yehoba ꞌoina,

ta siꞌinaneya ꞌabehega topeuina mwalo Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌana ꞌahwaꞌeda ꞌausalana deina ꞌimiyamiya ma ꞌiloloꞌahwaꞌahwanoi ꞌana lema weyahina, ꞌoinega sisalutuwa ma sihenainaida madouna ꞌina bwebweꞌana hila weyahina.
Pita ꞌina guguya
Tutaina loheyaina Pita ma Yoni ꞌiꞌabiꞌabi yahidi Hada Heꞌasisi papena, tauna sihesaniyeya Solomoni ꞌina biliupa, ta bodaedi maꞌidi henainaida sipili hegogona ꞌoidiya.

Ma Pita ꞌiꞌitediya, ꞌoinega boda ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Comi meIsileli, toꞌaha weyahina nuwami ꞌihenainaida ma waꞌeꞌebubumai? Geya ꞌabehega tauma ꞌima waiwaiyega bo nuwana ꞌima mumuga bwebweꞌana ꞌoinega, loheya bewa ꞌaꞌabihe bwebweꞌaneya ta ꞌitautau,

ma hesi Yehoba ꞌina waiwaiyega, tauna Ebalahamo ma Aisake ma Yakobo ꞌidi Yehoba, ta tubudao ꞌidi Yehoba. Yehobaina ꞌina hewali Yesu sanina ꞌiꞌabihaneheya, tauna mwalo Pailato nuwanuwana ma ꞌilihasi, ma ꞌomi wamwehihiyeya, ta waꞌahwa galagalaeya Pailato matana.
“Moisa tuwa, Yesu tauna loheya dumwaluna ma bwebweꞌana, ma hesi walogwahateya, ta tomota ꞌadi toloheꞌamasa ꞌaigeda nuwanuwami, ta weyahina Pailato ꞌoina waꞌahwanoiyeya.
Coinega yawasi bwebweꞌana ꞌana toꞌebwaya waloheꞌamasiya, ma Yehoba tauna ꞌamasega ꞌiꞌabihetoholo hileya, ta mabwaiyama ꞌaꞌiteya.
Coinega Yesu saninega loheya bewa ꞌibwebweꞌana pwaiya. Loheya bewa waꞌiteya ma wasanapuya, ma Yesu sanina ꞌihemiseya, ꞌoinega matamiya ꞌibwebweꞌana moisa ma ꞌihewaiwaiya.
“Tasigwao, yasanapugomiya ꞌabehega ꞌimi henuwa potepotega Yesuina waloheꞌamasiya, gidemusa ꞌimi babadao.
Ma hesi wada nuwahila ꞌabehega Yehoba ꞌina palopitao ꞌoidiyega ꞌihepwaila nugeta beno Toꞌabihetena ꞌina muyao ꞌilobadi, ꞌoinega gwaeina ꞌana moisa ꞌilatu pwaiya.
Coinega ꞌilobwainegomiya wanuwabui ma ꞌimi puiyao ꞌiꞌewayahuledi, ma lotohona bwebweꞌana waloba Bada tauna ꞌoinega,
ta wete Toꞌabihetenaina tauna ꞌihesinuwa nugeteya, ꞌihewasae ꞌoimiya, beno Yesu.
Tauna ꞌitauya pwaiya galewa, ma ꞌimiyamiya ꞌana siga ginaula mabwaiyadi ꞌiꞌabihe dumwaludi, gidemusa Yehoba ꞌina palopitao mwalona sihepwaileya.
Mwalo Mosese wete ꞌigwae hemisa, ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: ꞌCabwa ꞌida Bada Yehoba ꞌoimiyega ꞌaigeda loheya ꞌiꞌabilagasi ma ꞌihepalopita weyahimi, gidemusa taugu ꞌiꞌabi lagasigauwa, ma ꞌina hepwaila mabwaiyami nata wahesagohedi.
Ma ꞌeguma taiyawedi palopitaina ꞌina gwae silogwahate Yehoba ꞌiꞌabihegaladi, ma ꞌiꞌewa yahuledi ꞌina tomotaedi ꞌoidiyega.’

content: Ma palopita mabwaiyadi Samuwela ꞌoinega ma taudi simuliyeya ꞌoidiya, ꞌidi gwae hemisa ꞌoidiyega sihepwaila nugeta paihowaedi bewa tuwa weyahidi.
Ma ꞌomi palopitaowedi tubumiyao. Ma wete gwae hemisaina Yehoba tubudai Ebalahamo ꞌiꞌebwaeya, ꞌigwae,

content.text: ꞌCowa ꞌino susuwega ꞌabwa ꞌebeloinao mabwaiyadi baleꞌuwa ꞌidi ꞌebeyaliyaya.’

content: Coinega gwae hemisaina bewa ꞌomi wete weyahimi.
Ma Yehoba ꞌina hewali Yesu ꞌiꞌabihe toholoya, ta ꞌomi meYudiya ꞌoimiya ꞌihetune nugeteyama, ma ꞌina helau ꞌoimiya beno ꞌabehega ꞌimi puiyao ꞌoidiyega wanuwabui, ma hali bodao muliyetega.”
